contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ FL IVL CRISPVS N[OB] CAES ; R/ PRINCIPI IVV[ENTVTIS]

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Crispus (317-326), Principia Iuventutis, mint of London issue of 318, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Laureate bust draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: FL IVL CRISPVS N[OB] CAES. Reverse description: Mars standing right holding vertical spear and shield; crescent in left field. Reverse inscription: PRINCIPI IVV[ENTVTIS]. In exergue: PLN. Cliff…
